name: scheduler_send_media_via_adapter
notes: Per-file MEDIA routing decision (voice/video/image/document) from _send_media_via_adapter; harness carries a VERBATIM traced copy of the REAL scheduler_route_media port (its TU drags ~18 out-of-path externals, so linking is unclean); twin drives the routing through LIVE should_send_media_as_audio + LIVE _VIDEO_EXTS/_IMAGE_EXTS. Adapter delivery (network send) is out of path. DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES avoided: (1) C port does not lowercase the extension while LIVE does Path(...).suffix.lower(), so uppercase-extension inputs diverge — REAL GAP worth a follow-up fix; (2) LIVE _AUDIO_EXTS includes '.m2a' but the C audio table omits it — REAL GAP; (3) a hidden dotfile like '.ogg' has Path.suffix == '' in LIVE but strrchr finds the leading dot in C — avoided.
